entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So you're the one who grew these,[n]Senpai.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You can just call me Haru.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The seasons are changing soon, so[n]I thought it'd be nice for the plants[n]to change as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This time, it's a Yusuke Kitagawa[n]production.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All I did was add some... how do I put it...[n]aesthetic simplicity by balancing the color[n]placement.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Furthermore, Haru chose the flowers[n]herself. It will surely be a great bed[n]no matter the arrangement.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, I'm looking forward to it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Why don't we plant you, Mona?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Weren't you a shut-in until just recently?[n]You'd better photosynthesize while[n]you're here.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well, let's get started!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps the snapdragon should go[n]two more millimeters to the left...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's not gonna make a difference!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, y'know how we're thinkin' of the[n]school festival as our celebration party?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyone else think we should have a real[n]celebration on top of that?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must agree.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It would be not only a celebration, but[n]a welcoming as well. I'd like to do[n]something among ourselves.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's do it then! A joint party to celebrate[n]and to welcome Haru!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, you don't have to do that. The school[n]festival is more than enough.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How is everyone else supposed to get[n]excited if the star of the party's not into it?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well then... how about a night party?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: At Destinyland.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By Destinyland, do you mean that[n]kingdom of dreams?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It would be a bit late, but there are some[n]plans that allow us to rent out the park[n]for the night.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The entire park!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're talking about THE Destinyland,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Didn't you say you'd like to do something[n]amongst ourselves?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I did, but...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hold on. I'll go check.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She really thinks like a celebrity...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The heck's she gonna check?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Guys, it looks like it will work!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're really gonna have it at[n]Destinyland?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not like, one of the restaurants, but...[n]the entire park?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Even just for one night... the price is[n]insane...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, that won't be a problem.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We had originally booked it for a[n]company party, then had to call it off[n]because of the scandal...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We'd barely get anything back if we[n]canceled the reservation, so why not[n]take advantage of it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wouldn't that be oddly conspicuous[n]though?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's still officially under the company's[n]name. We needn't worry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: In that case... let's do this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We'll just celebrate twice as hard today!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry for disrupting everyone.[n]You did come to help me, after all.[n]Well, let's get back to it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So seriously. How much does it cost?
It seems like we'll be having our[n]celebration at Destinyland tonight...
